leadText:
Pikachu Shocks Back issue 2 is the sixth monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the sixth chapter of the manga, To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!. 

The contents of this issue were included as part of along with ET05, ET07, and ET08.

==Publications==
 
 

 

==Chapters==
To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!

==Important events==
and meet Mikey.
Mikey (and Ash) are challenged to a battle against his brothers after not evolving his Eevee for The Knights of the E Stone.
Mikey and Ash win the battle.
Mikey and Ash are accepted into The Knights of the E Stone, although Ash refuses.
